summary: This guide details an extremely effective free-to-play team for Temporal Vortex built around undead summoned units. By pairing Eleuia, Isitarian, and Zadok, players can out-damage premium Legendary Dauntless and Ice Blast teams. Eleuia spawns spirits on basic attacks, Isitarian buffs summoned units, and Zadok gains ultimate energy and up to +100% Attack whenever summoned units die. Garius acts as the sole front-line tank/healer, supported by Synarell or Torrin for survival.

heroes.name: Zadok
heroes.note: Gains 5% ultimate energy and Attack stacks (up to 30 stacks for +100% Attack) whenever an allied summoned unit dies, allowing him to rapidly spam his ultimate.

heroes.name: Eleuia
heroes.note: Spawns spirits every 5 basic attacks and grants Attack Speed Up and Attack Up to undead summoned units; build with maximum Attack Speed and Skill Haste.

heroes.name: Isitarian
heroes.note: Summons a dragon remnant and buffs undead summoned units with Attack and Defense; build with high Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

heroes.name: Garius
heroes.note: Requires maxed skills and high HP/Defense in a Skill Haste set to sustain the team and absorb frontline boss attacks.

heroes.name: Synarell
heroes.note: Provides invincibility to ensure the tank survives single-target boss burst, though replaceable by Torrin or Felosia.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.note: Can replace Synarell to provide strong healing and debuff immunity if invincibility is not needed.

teams.note: F2P Necrotic/Summoner composition where dying spirits constantly trigger Zadok's passive for massive ultimate damage, outperforming Dauntless and Ice Blast teams.

meta_changes: F2P Undead Summoner synergy (Eleuia + Isitarian + Zadok) matches or out-damages expensive Legendary Dauntless and Ice Blast lineups in Temporal Vortex.
tips: Equip Zadok with Witch's Remains or Volcanic Disc to maximize ultimate damage and inflict Defense Penalty on the boss.
Build Eleuia with high Attack Speed and Skill Haste to increase the frequency of spirit summons.
Position Garius alone in the front row with high HP, Defense, and Skill Haste gear.
Choose familiars carefully: Rejuvenating Stonehorn applies Vulnerability, offering significantly higher total damage than incorrect familiars.
Save summoning dice for the upcoming Child of Chaos banner.
